summary: [P2] Preserve the existing optional-features capability response
failure_scenario: An online older Gateway can return valid models/skills/tools without the optional features property. The old /capabilities route normalizes the same payload to features:[], but the new /settings route instead returns node.state=online with read_failed, live_capabilities:null and ready:false. Web now exclusively uses the new route, permanently locking an otherwise usable Agent. Independent Fastify HTTP injection with a genuine binding reproduced both responses. Preserve the existing missing-features normalization rather than rejecting the whole capability read; frontend CapabilitySnapshot also explicitly documents this older-Gateway compatibility.

summary: [P2] Preserve unknown historical Skill selection states
failure_scenario: When a committed profile version changes while offline, readSettingsSnapshot correctly downgrades discovered Skills to enabled:null and derived_current:false. This adapter erases null, and SkillSourceSelector:59-61 then considers every historical option selected under default_discovery. Independent rendering of the real component produced a green pill with aria-pressed=true and an enabled count of 1/1 for an unconfirmed historical Skill. The generic incomplete-list notice does not correct those concrete enabled indicators. Preserve the unknown/display provenance instead of reconstructing current enabled state from the old discovery list, as required by design:126 and incident R2.

summary: [P2] Do not interpret every read-only transition as an offline node
failure_scenario: With the node still online and HEARTBEAT.md already loaded, any main-settings refetch, pending operation or read failure sets readOnly=true. This new effect sets hbMdNodeOnline=false, causing lines 599-602 to say Node is offline. Becoming ready again never restores that value, so the false offline message persists until the preview is explicitly reopened and successfully reread. readOnly includes refreshing/failed/pending as well as actual disconnects; classify actual connection state separately from preview freshness and read errors.
